CREATE TABLE `runtime_external_payload_deletions` (
  `id` varchar(26) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `namespace` varchar(191) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `storage_uri` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `storage_uri_sha256` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `storage_policy` json NOT NULL,
  `attempts` int unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `failure_code` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `runtime_payload_deletions_namespace_uri_unique` (`namespace`,`storage_uri_sha256`),
  KEY `runtime_payload_deletions_namespace_created_index` (`namespace`,`created_at`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
